description: Rotate all pages, or only the listed ones, clockwise by 90, 180 or 270 degrees, and save the rotation permanently in a new PDF.

output.description: Where to write the result. Defaults to a new file beside the input. Existing files are never overwritten; a free name like file-1.pdf is used instead.

pages.description: Pages to rotate, for example "1, 3-4". Default: every page.

password.description: Password for a PDF that asks for one when opened. Used only on this machine.

name: rotate_pdf
title: Rotate PDF pages
